How direct billing works

Members buy from the vendor direct. The vendor ships to the member and bills PRO; PRO bills the member and keeps a share. The vendor's cash discount for paying on time is split between what PRO keeps and what passes on to the member. Member terms work out as: cash discount − PRO share − special deduction.
